title: Coordination SCO's biggest strength
desc: Modern threats do not wait for governments to agree on how to respond together. Drug networks, cybercriminals, human trafficking and extremist groups move across borders faster than many institutions can act. States often move more slowly, especially when they have to cooperate. Especially when political trust is limited. This is why coordination, even without perfect agreement, has become one of the most valuable assets in international security.
